name: Basis Theory
description: Agentic payments API that mints single-purchase card credentials from a customer-approved allowance over Visa, Mastercard Agent Pay and Stripe rails, so agents never see raw cards.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Creates an allowance, a customer-approved mandate limiting the merchant, amount and expiry an agent may spend.

skills.name: Mint Agent Card Credentials
skills.description: Mints a single-purchase credential from an allowance: a Visa or Mastercard agentic token or a Stripe shared payment token.

skills.name: Run Agent on Card Data
skills.description: Runs agent code inside a PCI-compliant Reactor so it can work with card data while the app stays out of PCI scope.

skills.name: Pay from Browser Automation
skills.description: Fills a merchant's checkout from browser automation via Browser Proxy without the agent or app handling the card.
